headline: Board Meeting Intimation for Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Six Months Ended 30Th September, 2026
body: ITC Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 02/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company along with the Segment-wise Revenue, Results, Assets and Liabilities for the Quarter and Six Months ended 30th September, 2026, the Balance Sheet as on that date, the Statement of Cash Flows for the half year ended on that date and the Notes thereto.
